Why Track Programs Order Factory-Direct

Track kit is deceptively technical. A singlet is a small amount of fabric, but the wrong weight makes it cling, the wrong armhole chafes over 5k, and cheap sublimation goes chalky after a month of sun and chlorine-heavy laundry. Most school programs buy whatever the local supplier stocks and live with it.

Specifying the garment properly costs no more when you buy direct: 110-140 GSM mesh for racing singlets, a longer body cut for cross-country, flatlock seams everywhere that matters. Twenty pieces covers a squad, boys' and girls' cuts of the same design count toward one minimum, and the artwork stays on file for the next intake. Test us first with a trial order, or browse the wider sportswear range.

Questions

What is the minimum order for custom track uniforms?

20 pieces per design. Men's and women's cuts of the same design count toward the same minimum, and youth through adult sizes mix freely in one order.

How much does a custom running singlet cost?

Quoted per design within 24 hours. Singlets sit at the lower end of the sublimated range on our published pricing page because of the small fabric area; shorts, half-tights and unitards are itemised separately.

Can you match our school's exact colours?

Yes. Send a Pantone reference or a photo of the current kit and we colour-match in the sample, which you approve before bulk production.

Do you make cross-country kit as well as track?

Yes - cross-country sets use a lighter mesh and a longer body cut than sprint singlets, with flatlock seams for distance comfort, from the same 20-piece minimum.

How long does a track kit order take?

Design mockup in 24-48 hours, sample in 5-7 business days, production 2-3 weeks, express DDP delivery 3-7 days - order before the outdoor season opens.
